name: Secret envelope sweep (expired envelopes, old envelope events)

knobs.note: BH-7965: 1 (the default, dry-run first) makes the sweep count only, read as ${SECRET_ENVELOPE_SWEEP_DRY_RUN:-1}. Any value other than 0 or 1 is one ALERTS line and no request. The retention window and batch are settings rows secret_envelope_events_retention_days and secret_envelope_sweep_batch, read by the worker. 0 = dry run off: a real run, expired envelopes are deleted and old events are archived and then deleted.
